title: prompt-lineage-capture-and-priority-rollforward-ci-hook
author: Maya Chen
commits: Initial implementation of lineage snapshot module
Add CI hook for prioritized rollforward logic and API integration
Add unit tests and docs, fix edge cases for missing anchor IDs
description:
Motivation: Prompt regressions often require surgical rollbacks targeted to the prompt cohorts that contributed to the regression signal. Existing CI gates mark whole prompt-sets as failed and trigger broad rollbacks which are expensive and noisy. This PR introduces a prompt-lineage capture utility and a CI hook that computes a prioritized rollforward/rollback plan based on prompt ancestry, recent deploys, and per-prompt failure impact.

What this does: - Adds eval/lineage/lineage_snapshot.py to record prompt metadata (prompt_id, prompt_version, seed_inputs, anchor_hash, source_test_suite, model_variant, ingestion_timestamp) and emit compact snapshots alongside CI eval artifacts. - Adds ci/hooks/priority_rollforward.py which consumes snapshot artifacts + eval diffs and computes a ranked action list (rollback candidate score, estimated rollback blast radius, suggested canary fraction). The hook returns structured decisions used by the CI orchestrator to create targeted rollforward patches or flag for manual review. - Provides a small heuristic scorer that blends regression delta, prompt exposure (token volume), and lineage centrality to prioritize actions. - Adds unit tests (tests/ci/test_priority_rollforward.py) and example notebook for on-demand inspection. - Documentation and usage guide at docs/ci/prompt-lineage.md.

Checklist: - [x] Unit tests added and passing locally - [x] Lint rules satisfied - [x] Doc guide and example notebook included - [x] Backwards-compatible: snapshots are optional; hook tolerates missing lineage metadata

Related: ENG-1124 (prompt SLOs), ENG-1187 (selective rollback runner). This PR is intentionally conservative: it does not automate destructive rollbacks, only surfaces a ranked plan. Follow-ups will wire the plan into the rollout runner under feature flags.
review_comments: Ethan: Nice separation of concerns. Can you add a short circuit if there are no matching anchor_hashes to avoid extra work?
Maya: Added short-circuit and defensive checks in commit 2; updated tests to cover empty-snapshot case.
Priya: The scoring weights seem to favor volume heavily; can we expose these as runtime config and default to lower volume weighting?
Maya: Exposed weights in ci/config/rollforward_policy.yaml and documented defaults in docs. Also added integration test to validate config override.
Liam: Request to surface the top-3 contributing prompt IDs in CI logs for easier triage. Also asked for an example of the plan JSON.
Maya: Added plan.summary.top_contributors and example output in docs; CI logger now prints compact top-3 in INFO logs.
merge_outcome: merged after one rebase; no conflicts
release_notes: Add prompt lineage snapshotting and a CI hook that computes prioritized rollback/rollforward plans for prompt regressions. Non-destructive by default; exposes config to tune scoring and can be enabled behind feature flags.
notes_for_release: This PR introduces on-disk snapshot artifacts next to eval runs (small JSON blobs). Ensure CI storage quota accounts for extra files.
Ops: If auto-rollout wiring is enabled in the future, require extra approvals and safety checks.
